_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 03: 2023-06-29 to 2023-08-25, completing 2023. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says Saudi Arabia joins BRICS on 1 January 2024 alongside Argentina, Egypt and the UAE, taking eighty percent of the world's oil wealth, leaving five months to prepare.
mentions.quote: they are going to join the brakes Nation on January the 1st of 2024
mentions.time_phrase: January the 1st of 2024, five months left
mentions.falsify_match: All four accede to BRICS on 1 January 2024.
mentions.falsify_miss: One or more declines or delays.

mentions.claim_text: He points to Japan releasing radioactive water from its power plant into the ocean, and to Trump's mug shot on the 24th as something never done to a former president.
mentions.quote: poisoning all of the ocean with their uh Power Plant
mentions.falsify_match: Current events he reads as significant, not a forward claim.

mentions.claim_text: He has seen a short brown-haired woman doing something in November and coming alongside Kamala Harris the way Ford came alongside Nixon, and says he cannot see how the expected 2024 outcome is possible.
mentions.quote: coming along beside Carmela Harris kind of like how Ford and and uh Nixon did
mentions.falsify_match: A succession in which Harris rises and a woman is elevated alongside her, as Ford was to Nixon.

mentions.claim_text: He says great things are coming for 2024 and for the Democratic Party, and answers viewers annoyed that he mentions politics at all.
mentions.quote: showed me great things coming for 2024. the Democratic party
mentions.falsify_match: The Democratic Party has a strong 2024.
mentions.falsify_miss: The Democratic Party loses badly in 2024.

mentions.claim_text: Going into 2024 he sees the economy pumped full of money to make everything look good, and the Lord warns that 2024 will be a year to soar and a good year, though not good in every aspect.
mentions.quote: 2024 will be a year that we will soar great great sore
mentions.falsify_match: Large fiscal or monetary stimulus in 2024 and a year widely read as good.
mentions.falsify_miss: 2024 is a bad year on his own terms.

mentions.claim_text: Another wave is coming, this one built on digital platforms and digital cryptos, with a shifting into a new era of things.
mentions.quote: I saw it being with digital platforms digital cryptos
mentions.falsify_match: A broad shift into digital asset platforms comparable to the early 2000s internet wave.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is something about August 24th and something about praying over September, admits he hates quoting dates because of depth perception in the spirit, and adds that there will be a generation that does not see death.
mentions.quote: I hate quoting dates ever because when you're singing the spirit
mentions.falsify_match: A shift dated to late August or September 2023.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing of note in either month.

mentions.claim_text: Repeating the 2024 word from prayer the night before, he says it will be a year the body of Christ soars.
mentions.quote: it's going to be a year that we sore
mentions.falsify_match: 2024 is a year of visible flourishing for the church.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a great financial harvest with the years and months ahead stacked like dominoes, and the Lord names three things: a financial shifting, a catastrophic event, and an outpouring of his spirit.
mentions.quote: There's going to be a financial shifting. There's going to be a catastrophic event
mentions.time_phrase: the years and the months ahead
mentions.falsify_match: A monetary regime change, a catastrophe and a religious revival, in that order.
mentions.falsify_miss: The three do not occur, or occur in no relation to one another.

mentions.claim_text: He restates that 2024 is not a bad year but a blessed one, framing it as a coin you can read either way and calling it a choice.
mentions.quote: And 2024 is not a bad year. It's a blessed year
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as stated: he supplies the coin device that makes either outcome readable as fulfilment.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks healing and the mind of Christ over his daughter Megan rather than describing her behaviour, as an example of not speaking death.
mentions.quote: Megan is healed by the stripes of Jesus
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a confession of faith over a family member.

mentions.claim_text: Encouragement that undoing years of wrong speech takes time, and that God will set the hearer free with the same power that freed him.
mentions.quote: God is faithful and he's going to set you free
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation, no observable criterion.

mentions.claim_text: Testimony that a woman gave him a check for $3,500 saying the Lord told her to pay off his hospital bills, when his wages were about to be garnished.
mentions.quote: The Lord told me to pay off your hospital bills
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: past personal testimony.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not know where the channel is going, only that God told him to be on YouTube, and notes he has reached fifty thousand subscribers since starting around February.
mentions.quote: God told me to be on YouTube
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: channel history, no claim about the world.

mentions.claim_text: Closing prayer calling healing, deliverance and restored marriages over viewers, built on an image of a large bird dropping worms to feed its young.
mentions.quote: I call Healing over your bodies I call Deliverance over you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession, no observable criterion.

mentions.claim_text: Encouragement to keep standing for healing and finances, promising that God will bring provision as he sent a raven to feed Elijah.
mentions.quote: he'll bring a raven to feed you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation, no observable criterion.

mentions.claim_text: He was told to pray against mass shootings at large gatherings, calling them an assignment sent to take the Second Amendment away, with campaigns to be run on it.
mentions.quote: pray against big large Gatherings of people for Mass
mentions.condition_text: he is given it as a prayer assignment to stop
mentions.time_phrase: they're going to run on campaigns
mentions.falsify_match: Mass shootings at large gatherings followed by gun control becoming a campaign platform.

mentions.claim_text: He dates the volcano warning to a prayer time around April in the summer of 2022, when the Lord told him a massive volcano was coming.
mentions.quote: he said Brandon there's going to be a ma
mentions.falsify_match: A massive volcanic eruption of the kind described.

mentions.claim_text: He gives the angel's countdown as 510 days landing on 2 October, set during Yom Kippur and Rosh Hashanah of the previous year, and says the Lord told him near the date that he was extending the time frame and pushing it back to give people more time to repent.
mentions.quote: 510 days it's October the 2nd is what the date came to
mentions.falsify_match: A judgment-scale event on or about 2 October 2023.
mentions.falsify_miss: The date passes without one, which he pre-attributes to an extension granted for repentance.

mentions.claim_text: He says what is about to start happening is very serious and will fall like dominoes, and admits outright that he sometimes misses timing because depth perception in the spirit makes things arrive faster or slower than he saw.
mentions.quote: I missed timing sometimes whenever I'm seeing and I'm praying
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as stated, and important for that reason: it pre-authorises any timing miss.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts having bought chickens on an earlier warning that never came, apologising to his wife for missing it, then saying either it was averted by prayer or it was simply early, since chicken shortages are now in the news in 2023.
mentions.quote: I guess that was averted we prayed it away or something
mentions.condition_text: he offers averting prayer as the explanation for the earlier non-event
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as framed: the miss is absorbed either as averted or as early.

mentions.claim_text: In the 2014 visitation Jesus told him urgently to tell his people he is coming, and showed him things about time frames he was told he could not repeat.
mentions.quote: Tell my people I'm coming
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the datable content is explicitly withheld.

mentions.claim_text: He says aliens are becoming the norm and no longer taboo, with the government now talking about it, and that he told people in 2014 it would be the big deal.
mentions.quote: The government's talking about it. It's It's almost becoming taboo
mentions.falsify_match: Official disclosure normalises the subject in public life.

mentions.claim_text: He states his own position that he goes in the first round of the rapture before the tribulation, while allowing that if the reading is wrong those left should seek him out for what to do next.
mentions.quote: I'm going to go in the first round. I'm going with Jesus in the rapture
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable within any lifetime: a pre-tribulation position with no date.

mentions.claim_text: During the 2014 tribulation vision he saw a Starbucks standing where a barbecue house then stood, and told his children there would be a Starbucks there in the tribulation before Christ returns.
mentions.quote: there'll be a Starbucks there during the tribulation right before Jesus comes back
mentions.falsify_match: A Starbucks is built on that site, which he says has since happened.
mentions.falsify_miss: The site never becomes a Starbucks.

mentions.claim_text: He says buildings he saw in the tribulation vision that did not exist in 2014 are being built now, including the announced new Starbucks, and calls it a moment of awe.
mentions.quote: the buildings that I saw in tribulation that didn't exist
mentions.falsify_match: The specific buildings he described in 2014 are verifiably built later.
mentions.falsify_miss: They are not, or the description is too loose to check.
